QuestInfo.name: Council President's Order 2
QuestInfo.0: Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Anthony asks you to bring more resources to help develop Edelstein. He needs 2 Refined Plates. What kind of city is he running that he always needs to ask you for resources?\n\n#i4011000##t4011000#  #b#c4011000# / 2#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought 2 Bronze Plates to Anthony.

0.0: URRGH! It's still not enough! Edelstein will go broke in 4 days at this rate! Ah, and I was so looking forward to the new building... Citizen, can I count on you to provide for the people once again?

yes.0: Some #bBronze Plates#k are what the city budget needs. Not Bronze Ore, but refined Plates! About #b2#k of them should do the trick... You DO know how to refine Bronze, I assume. Just find an anvil and...I don't have to tell you where to find an anvil, too, do I?

no.0: Huh. You're not one of those anarchist-types, are you?

1.0: Ah, the Bronze Plates! Good, good! Now that we have the resources, we can get to work on the new council president mansion... Pwahaha!

yes.0: Well done. I'll come to you first if the city needs more help.

item.0: Those aren't #bBronze Plates#k! If you don't have the right skills, just buy it from someone who does! Don't you have any common sense?
